$comment: The franchise walk's regression corpus: big franchises with many films, specials and spin-offs (One Piece, Naruto, Bleach, Dragon Ball, Detective Conan, Gintama, Pokémon, Lupin III, Fate, Monogatari, JoJo, Attack on Titan, My Hero Academia), runs that start with an OVA or a film before a TV series (R.O.D, FLCL, Berserk), runs that hold no TV series (Kara no Kyoukai, Persona 3 the Movie, Gunbuster, and Sakura Taisen and Patlabor, whose TV series Kitsu lists as a version), and films that name a series their parent story (Bleach, Naruto, Detective Conan, One Piece, SPY×FAMILY), recorded from kitsu.io/api/edge.

cases.json.source: Hand-written: one case per anchor, what the walk must answer for it (the title of the run's first entry by start, which section holds the anchor, a side story's parent stories, ids a section must hold), pinned by backend/src/commands/franchise_corpus_test.rs.

listings.json.source: Recorded by backend/src/commands/franchise_corpus_record_test.rs: the franchise walk run from every anchor in cases.json, each listing it asked for read with the app's query (KitsuClient::franchise_relations) and each detail with KitsuClient::anime_detail, artwork dropped (the walk never reads it).
listings.json.captured_at: 2026-11-11; My Hero Academia's seasons and its second and fourth films 2026-11-12
